column2: to be consumed by BPF programs. BPF currently supports a

column1: kernel -> user-space circular ring buffer via the BPF_MAP_TYPE_RINGBUF

as none of the helpers exported for BPF_MAP_TYPE_RINGBUF will apply
to a user-space producer ring buffer
column2: and we'll want to add one or

column1: more helper functions that would not apply for a kernel-producer
ring buffer.
This patch therefore adds a new BPF_MAP_TYPE_USER_RINGBUF map type
definition. The map type is useless in its current form
way to access or use it for anything until we one or more BPF helpers. A
follow-on patch will therefore add a new helper function that allows BPF
programs to run callbacks on samples that are published to the ring
buffer.
